chapters.title: Amount field types in Business Central
Selecting debit and credit field display

features.name: Show amounts field setting
features.description: Configuration option on General Ledger Setup page that allows users to choose between viewing amount fields as a single field (for debit/credit entry) or as separate debit and credit amount fields plus local currency counterparts.
caveats: Setting applies company-wide to all users, not per individual user

features.name: Amount field with sign notation
features.description: Default behavior in Business Central where amount fields accept both debit and credit amounts in the same field using a sign in front of the amount to distinguish between them based on the scenario.

features.name: Separate debit and credit amount fields
features.description: Alternative display mode where distinct debit and credit amount fields are shown alongside local currency counterparts, providing a clearer overview of field balancing.

quotes.text: You type in amounts in the same field regardless if the amount is a debit or credit amount.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the default behavior of amount fields in Business Central, where a single field is used for both debit and credit entries.

quotes.text: You use a sign in front of the amount to determine if the amount is debit or credit depending on the scenario.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the mechanism for distinguishing between debit and credit amounts in the default single-field approach.

quotes.text: I'd like to work with the debit and credit fields, so I select debit and credit only.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical selection of the debit and credit display option in the Show amounts field setting.

quotes.text: When you change this setting, it applies company-wide and not only for the current user. It applies for all users.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important limitation: the amount field display setting is a company-wide configuration, not a per-user preference.
